answer_1.quote: We prompted each LLM to generate a news article given a headline.

answer_2.quote: We examined properties of our benchmark texts using internal and external statistical criteria: the former refer to measurements of the characteristics of the human-and machine-generated texts... For the internal criteria, we compute (i) baseline counts (no. of syllables, words and sentences), (ii) compression ratio..., (iii) readability..., and (iv) part-of-speech distribution heterogeneity.
